key.name: host
key.description: Host name or address of the machine running upsd.

key.name: port
key.description: TCP port upsd listens on. The default is 3493.

key.name: ups-name
key.description: Name of the UPS as configured in ups.conf. Leave empty to use the first UPS the server reports.

key.name: username
key.description: User name from upsd.users. Leave empty when no authentication is required.

key.name: password
key.description: Password matching the user name. Stored in dconf as plain text.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often the UPS is polled, in seconds.

key.name: connection-timeout
key.description: How long to wait for the server before giving up, in seconds.

key.name: panel-label
key.summary: Text shown in the top bar
key.description: Which value is shown next to the icon in the top bar.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator is placed in.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items of that section. 0 is leftmost; a value beyond the number of items puts it last.

key.name: show-menu-detail
key.summary: Show detailed rows in the menu
key.description: Show voltages, battery voltage and nominal power in the menu.

key.name: notify-on-battery
key.summary: Notify when the UPS switches to battery
key.description: Show a notification when a power failure is detected.

key.name: notify-low-battery
key.description: Show a notification when the UPS reports a low battery.

key.name: notify-on-line
key.description: Show a notification when the UPS is back on line power.

key.name: notify-replace-battery
key.summary: Notify when the battery needs replacing
key.description: Show a notification when the UPS reports the replace battery flag.

key.name: notify-comm-lost
key.description: Show a notification when the NUT server cannot be reached several times in a row.
